title: Balanced integral reindexing and common-stage realization descent
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite-field datum D and objectwise SpaceData d(T) as in [def-sf-adic-realization-isomorphism-data]. For geometric spaces T,U over D and an underlying scheme isomorphism g:T→U, let B be a function-normalized RingReindex between their native coefficient rings [def-sf-native-adic-reindexing-data]. There are normalized IntegralReindex maps I(E) at all finite coefficient fields, and a natural isomorphism from common-stage pullback followed by ordinary realization on T to ordinary realization on U followed by module-derived inverse image along B. On each integral representative the isomorphism satisfies integralRealizationAgreement with I(E). No tensor or identity/composition coherence is asserted.

source.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; HRS Lemma 7.9; explicit subargument of lem-sf-adic-reindexing-core, not a verbatim statement of either source.

proof.text: Obtain the family of balanced IntegralReindex maps from lem-sf-adic-integral-reindexing-maps.
Apply lem-sf-adic-realization-comparison-descent to that family to obtain the common-stage natural isomorphism and all integralRealizationAgreement equations.
Package the family, common-stage isomorphism, and agreement proof in the target existential.

theorem exists_integral_realization_reindexing (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (d : ∀ T : GeometricSpace D, SpaceData l D T)
    (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
    (B : RingReindex l T.base.left g.hom (d T).realization (d U).realization) :
    letI := (d T).units
    letI := (d U).units
    ∃ I : ∀ E, IntegralReindex l T.base.left g.hom B E,
    ∃ c : commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom ⋙
        ordinary l T.base.left (d T).realization ≅
      ordinary l U.base.left (d U).realization ⋙ derivedPull l T.base.left g.hom B,
    ∀ E, integralRealizationAgreement l g.hom (d T).realization (d U).realization
      B E (I E) c
